import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
for n in ['1807.08292','1504.00291']:
 z=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources'/f'{n}.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert z.returncode==0
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{n}.txt'],input=z.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print('FILE',n,'CHARS',len(z.stdout));print(z.stdout[:17000] if n=='1807.08292' else z.stdout[:14500])
